notes.title: New Update! New Virus Upgrades
notes.content:
Hi World Dominators,

Many of you requested that we bring back the virus upgrades from past Infectonator games, not as a modifier, but as a core in-game upgrade. We hear you, and that’s why we are proud to announce that we are bringing those features back to the core game! Let me present to you our latest update:

Virus Upgrades - You can now upgrade the main virus in the Lab’s support item tab. The upgrades include: additional virus vectors, wall penetration, chain reaction, and more. These upgrades are intended towards mid to late game so they are a bit pricey.

Zombie Max Level Increased - Zombies can now level up to level 10!

Difficulty Tweaks - Made changes to some stats to make the game less grindy, especially towards the end game. These changes include City infection meter, global events, and Human stats.

With these new updates we hope that destroying the world will be more enjoyable!

We would like to hear more from you, our players, for feedback. Leave a comment below or join our Discord channel https://discord.gg/toge if you’d like to discuss the game!

notes.title: New Update! Weekly Challenges and Global Leaderboard
notes.content:
Hi World Dominators,

We are proud to announce our latest update for Infectonator 3: Apocalypse. Let me present to you our latest features:

Weekly Challenge Mode - A set of random modifiers will be presented every week, you can play it regardless whether you’ve unlocked it or not. Also, you can retry the challenge without any limitation. Your highest score will be stored in the weekly leaderboard. The player with the highest score will be crowned “Player of The Week” and featured in the game’s main screen.

Global STEAM Leaderboard - Your highest scores will now be stored in the game’s Global Leaderboard. Compete with players from all around the world and become the best world conqueror! Also, you can now compare your scores with your friends.

Additionally, the game is now available in Polish, Thai, and Turkish!

We would like to hear more from you, our players, for feedback and suggestions. Leave a comment below or join our Discord channel https://discord.gg/toge and let us know what you think about the upcoming update and feel free to suggest new modifier ideas!

notes.title: Big Update 1.3.1! Leaderboard, Modifiers & Casual Mode
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31206337/6b2d6116958a190b914d191e7c4d608adff0f809.png[/img]

Hi World Dominators!
We are happy to announce our first BIG update for Infectonator 3: Apocalypse!
Here’s a list of the new things added with this update:

[list]
    [*][b]Casual Mode[/b] - A new game modifier for fans of the classic Infectonator. No cure and less panic. Enjoy this relaxing and therapeutic mode where you can destroy the world casually on your spare time. No modifier token is required to activate this mode.
    [*][b]Leaderboard System[/b] - You will be able to track your progress and beat your own high score! Post your score online and compete with EVERYONE to be the best in spreading infections and finishing fastest! And to make things fair, modifiers will affect your score positively or negatively.
    [*][b]Surrender Kill-Switch[/b] - Your doomsday plan fails mid game? Just flip the kill switch to cancel the apocalypse! You can quickly end your run and convert your score into exp points, then start a new apocalypse.
    [*][b]Auto-Open Body Bags[/b] - Added a toggle button to automatically open body bags
    [*][b]Bug fixes[/b]
[/list] 

Also, we are adding new modifiers for you to play with:

[list]
    [*][b]Randomized Zombie Loadout[/b] - Players are given free zombies on every attack, but Loadout are randomized every day.
    [*][b]Extra Zombie Slot[/b] – Adds an extra zombie loadout slot.
    [*][b]Reduced Zombie Capacity[/b] – Decreases zombie loadout capacity size.
    [*][b]Perfectionist Mode[/b] – You must get all humans in every attack, fail to do so 3 times and you’ll lose the game.
    [*][b]20/20 Vision[/b] – All humans have great eyesight. Activating this modifier will increases human view distance.
    [*][b]Bootleg Support Items[/b] – All support items are weaker.
    [*][b]Region Lockdown[/b] - Regions go into Lockdown after an attack for several days.
    [*][b]Evacuation Protocol[/b] – Stages have a time limit before it automatically ends.
[/list] 

We would like to hear more from you, our players, for feedback and suggestions. Leave a comment below or join our Discord channel https://discord.gg/toge and let us know what you think about the upcoming update and feel free to suggest new modifier ideas!

notes.title: Up Coming Update 1.2.6 and BETA Build Access
notes.content:
Hi World Dominators!

We are currently working on a new update for Infectonator 3: Apocalypse and we are opening access to the BETA build so that you can try these new features that are still in development, NOW! Please help us test these updates before we roll it out to the masses, we want to hear your feedback and suggestions so that we can make the game better.

To try the BETA build, open Infectonator 3: Apocalypse's game properties, go to the BETA tab, and select "public-testing" branch from the drop-down menu.

Here's the change-log for the public-testing BETA version 1.2.6 
[list]
    [*][b]Surrender Kill-Switch[/b] - Your doomsday plan fails mid game? Just flip the kill switch to cancel the apocalypse! You can quickly end your run and convert your score into exp points, then start a new apocalypse.
    [*][b]Auto-Open Body Bags[/b] - Added a toggle button to automatically open body bags
    [*]Change item icon in lab to gray if item is not unlocked
    [*]Fix doomon not appearing on continent destroyed if destroyed using nukes
    [*]Fix new game plus modifier for zombie stat
    [*]Fix starting money new game plus modifier bug
    [*]Fixing Disco Zombie behavior, when he is dancing, player can now spawn items/zombies without cooldown
[/list]

We are also working on other new features. Here is the list of things we are working on right now:
[list]
    [*][b]Casual Mode[/b] - A new game modifier for fans of the classic Infectonator. [i][b]No cure and less panic[/b][/i]. Enjoy this relaxing and therapeutic mode where you can destroy the world casually on your spare time. No modifier token is required to activate this mode.
    [*][b]Harder Difficulty Modifiers[/b] - For you who craves tougher challenges, we have something for you too! We are adding several new game modifiers that will make your doomsday planning a lot tougher than it should. You can make your life harder (if you wish) by toggling these modifiers. Scroll down for more details on the new modifiers.
    [*][b]Leaderboard System[/b] - You will be able to track your progress and beat your own high score! Post your score online and compete with EVERYONE to be the best in spreading infections and finishing fastest! And to make things fair, modifiers will affect your score positively or negatively.
[/list] 

Setting your own difficulty has been one of the most requested features. However, we noticed that it's not just the value of the variables (more health, lower damage, etc) that made the game harder or easier, but also how the player's play (your pacing and play style). To address this, we are adding new new-game modifiers so that you can adjust your own difficulty setting in a more meaningful way (not just changing variables).

We have both, positive and negative modifiers that will make the game harder or easier or more interesting. You'll be able to experiment with various modifiers combinations.
For more casual and relaxing play style we'll be introducing:
[list]
    [*][b]Casual Mode[/b] - mentioned above 
    [*][b]More Zombie Capacity[/b] - you can carry more zombies
    [*]many more
[/list] 

As for those wishing for more challenges we'll be adding these:
[list]
    [*][b]Strike Out[/b] - Fail three times and you are out! 
    [*][b]Random Zombie Loadout[/b] - With this modifier, you'll have a randomized zombie loadout every time you attack a city.
    [*][b]City Quarantine Lockdown[/b] - Attacked cities will be placed under quarantine lockdown for a few days. You can no longer attack a city twice in a row.
    [*]many more
[/list] 

We would like to hear more from you, our players, for feedback and suggestions. Leave a comment below or join our Discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/toge]https://discord.gg/toge[/url] and let us know what you think about the upcoming update and feel free to suggest new modifier ideas!

notes.title: Update - Difficulty Balancing & Modifiers Tweak
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31206337/7ce5d20e26525f5c1aa9ae34bf6cb85e4c703c23.png[/img]

Hi, World Dominators!

Thank you for being patient with us. We have been working hard to make Infectonator 3: Apocalypse better based on your feedback and suggestions. So, wait no longer! We are rolling out a new update, version 1.2.2, yay! Here are the changes:

[list]
    [*]Adjusted the exp requirement to level up and unlock modifier tokens
    [*]Tokens are now used to “equip” modifiers instead of unlocking them, you will get them back when the modifier is unequipped. This will allow players to experiment with modifier combinations more easily.
    [*]Adjusted the damage of support items
    [*]Adjusted the damage of some human weapons, especially soldiers and ZIT trooper attacks
    [*]Increased the amount of mutation chance gained per level of upgrade
    [*]You will receive the correct amount of zombies at the start of the game if tutorial is disabled
    [*]Labs on death door will be slowed down significantly
[/list]

I hope with this update the game will be more enjoyable for you to play. Let us know what you think about this new build in the comments section or join the discussion in our discord channel at [url=discord.gg/toge]discord.gg/toge[/url].

Cheers!
